If you actually want a public sentinel host now, say so and I bind abilifi-sentinel-kv — but I will not point the money surface at an unordered host on a shorthand.

FORECAST — #3 BEB-2897 D1-read residue, before I start:
- The residue: deploy token ([redacted] from vault) cannot resolve d1 BY NAME (lacks D1 read), so crm-db + any non-pinned d1 still fail the shell-gate. memplug is pinned; the rest are not.
- AUTH/approach: read the shell-gate resolve path in abilifi-mastra; option A = pin known d1 ids in mastra [vars] (uuid, not secret) for the few real stores; option B = make the shell-gate FAIL LOUD naming the d1 it could not resolve (per Fable D2) instead of falling through to memplug; option C = the token needs D1-read scope (that IS a re-mint — I will name it as the one thing that needs you, not guess around it).
- No secrets. Expected deploy: abilifi-mastra. Acceptance: crm-db (and any real d1) either resolves+binds, or FAILS LOUD by name — never silently binds the wrong db.
Starting the read now, staying vocal.

BEB-2897 D1-READ RESIDUE (#3) — DEPLOYED + gate-verified (m65959: deployed vs accepted separate).
- abilifi-mastra 110b72c6, deploy-verify PASS. Shell-gate fallback (live/index.js ~2061) FIXED: was falling back to abilifi-memplug for ANY unresolved d1 → silently bound the WRONG db (crm-db got memplug's data). Now a PINNED-ID MAP resolves the real stores by uuid (abilifi-memplug b45a5b37, abilifi-crm-db 7fe98385 — public ids from wrangler d1 list, not secrets), and a d1 NOT in the map FAILS LOUD by name instead of wrong-binding (Fable D2).
- ACCEPTANCE (time-based): the residual crm-db deploy fails (~308/24h) drop; unknown d1 shows a named SHELL_GATE fail, never a silent memplug bind. Reading the count from state, not claiming yet.
- Recorded operating rule cc-forecast-then-go: forecast ON SCREEN up front AND GO in the same motion — the forecast is a heads-up not a gate (Alex drilled it 2026-08-28).

INFRA QUEUE now: 1 2702 ✓closed · 2 2847 ✓core (types on graph) · 3 2897 D1-read ✓deployed(count pending) · NEXT 4 BEB-6845 splitter + 6834 patronage rows in Sentinel · 5 rescue+test Cue (2394). Forecasting #4 before I start.

#4 BEB-6845 splitter + 6834 patronage rows — BLOCKED on Sentinel source location (tried, verbatim gap).

Searched the abilifi-apps tree: NO abilifi-sentinel-kv dir, no dedicated Sentinel meter worker. reserve/settle logic lives only in the shared framework.ts (copied into frags) and sentinel-demo (a demo). The real Sentinel meter (mastra's SENTINEL=abilifi-sentinel-kv service binding) has its source OUTSIDE this repo — same gap as the sentinel host and the mcp.bebond.net backend.

So the buy-out ALLOCATION ROW on settle (6845) and the PATRONAGE ROW read (6834) need to be added to the Sentinel meter worker, whose source I cannot find here. Where does abilifi-sentinel-kv's source live (repo/dir)? Name it and I add the allocation + patronage rows.

Also on the record (rule 2): building the row MECHANISM is infra/mine, but the FIRST real patronage number (6834) reads LIVE ledger rows — I will build the read + the row-write mechanism, but a settle that moves real credit waits for your go.

Meanwhile locked graph-only-never-md as a node; #1-3 done (2702 closed, 2847 types-on-graph, 2897 D1-read pinned-map 110b72c6 gate-PASS).
WATCHDOG DIFF (BEB-3622): liveness FRESH→STALE — out-of-band, surfaced not blocking.

RE-READ THE CF AGENTS RELEASES — SIX MORE THINGS WE HAVE BEEN HAND-BUILDING. Doc 77226fcc
Top of the list: @cloudflare/computer, an agent runtime with a Workspace, isolate AND container backends via FUSE, and read/write/edit/ls/exec tools. That is what vlinux is for. Previewed 08-03.

AND BROWSER RUN WAS REBUILT ON DURABLE CDP — BEB-6772 MAY NOT EXIST ON THAT PATH
One browser_execute tool where the model WRITES CDP CODE: screenshots, rendered content, live sessions. Plus Live View URLs, OPTIONAL SESSION RECORDING, and pause-for-login that keeps tabs and cookies then resumes. That last one retires the mint_test_aj workaround.

AGENT SKILLS: a CATALOG in the prompt, activated only on match — that is the 5766 recall problem, shipped
A large library stops bloating every prompt. Same problem as agents forgetting after compaction. Also shipped: declarative timezone-aware SCHEDULED TASKS (the tick machinery), Telegram messengers (2568), and AGENT TRACING with turn/tool/approval/token waterfalls (much of /record).

STANDING RULE FROM THIS: CHECK WHAT CF SHIPS AT THE START OF EVERY DESIGN, before any library
Today that caught the whole video stack. This read caught six more. Also: Code Mode now pauses on approval-gated actions (HITL as a runtime feature), and x402 moved to v2 in February — check BEB-1105 against v2.

CC — BEB-6848 SHADER IN V8, TIMEBOXED TO ONE PASS. Yours
No GPU in an isolate, so this is software rasterisation in WASM: shader as a pure function of position and time, run per pixel on CPU, buffer out as PNG. MEASURE ms/frame at 390px and full size. That number decides it, not argument.

ONE PASS ONLY. A NO IS A RESULT AND CLOSES A LIVE QUESTION
If it does not produce a frame in that pass, report the number and STOP. Do not chase it, do not port a rasteriser. The container backend in 6847 and Browser Rendering are both already on the board and neither is blocked on this.

FRAMES TO R2: YES AS A TRANSIENT BUFFER, NEVER AS A STORE
Run-id prefix, consumed by the encoder, DELETED on success, abandoned runs sweepable. Only the finished video is retained. If renderer and encoder land in the same runtime the frames never touch R2 at all, which is better. No frame is ever a kept artefact.
